# VB6 behaviour oracle

Measured VB6 runtime behaviour: probes, results, types and the surprises that overturned earlier
assumptions. Measurements come from running the real VB6 compiler, with native and p-code results
recorded where they differ.

This repository is mirrored from [HexIDE's working copy](https://github.com/hexide-io/HexIDE/tree/main/docs/vb6-fidelity-oracle)
on merge. Write measurements there with the HexIDE change that needs them. To contribute from outside
HexIDE, [open an issue here](https://github.com/hexide-io/vb6-behaviour/issues); contributions are ported
to the working copy before being mirrored back. Direct edits to this mirror will be replaced.

The index below records the subjects, rules for adding measurements and instructions for building
native and p-code probes; it is copied from the working copy on every mirror run.
